description: This file contains functions and types related to replay history management, including sanitization, validation, and session snapshot handling for agent message histories in a conversational AI system.

methods.name: buildInterSessionPrefix
methods.description: Builds a prefix string for inter-session messages based on message provenance.

methods.name: annotateInterSessionUserMessages
methods.description: Annotates user messages with inter-session prefixes if they have relevant provenance.

methods.name: describeAssistantContentKind
methods.description: Returns a string describing the kind of assistant message content.

methods.name: canonicalizeAssistantHistoryMessages
methods.description: Repairs malformed assistant messages to ensure they conform to a canonical array-based content structure.

methods.name: parseMessageTimestamp
methods.description: Parses a timestamp value from string or number to a number, or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: stripStaleAssistantUsageBeforeLatestCompaction
methods.description: Removes or zeroes out assistant usage data for messages before the latest compaction point.

methods.name: normalizeAssistantUsageSnapshot
methods.description: Normalizes assistant usage data into a consistent snapshot format.

methods.name: normalizeAssistantUsageCost
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes cost information from usage data.

methods.name: toFiniteCostNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number if possible.

methods.name: ensureAssistantUsageSnapshots
methods.description: Ensures all assistant messages have normalized usage snapshots.

methods.name: createProviderReplaySessionState
methods.description: Creates an object managing custom session entries for replay, including get and append methods.

methods.name: readLastModelSnapshot
methods.description: Reads the most recent model snapshot entry from session manager entries.

methods.name: appendModelSnapshot
methods.description: Appends a new model snapshot entry to the session manager.

methods.name: isSameModelSnapshot
methods.description: Checks if two model snapshot entries are equivalent.

methods.name: sanitizeSessionHistory
methods.description: Performs comprehensive sanitization, validation, and snapshot management on message history before replay.

methods.name: validateReplayTurns
methods.description: Validates replay message turns, including provider-specific validation and fallback validation.
